title: Daily briefing: Rogue ‘jumping genes’ age bigs dogs faster than little ones
title_zh: 每日简报：流浪‘跳跃基因’让大型狗比小型狗更快衰老
abstract: Epigenetic genes accumulate faster in big dogs. Plus, what’s know about reports of plague in Russia and the legacy of software engineer Margaret Hamilton.
abstract_zh: 表观遗传基因在大型犬中更快累积。此外，了解俄罗斯瘟疫报告以及软件工程师玛格丽特·汉密尔顿的遗产。
